lines.t: I've been holding on to shadows
Trying not to lose my way
Every heartbeat felt so hollow
Till your whisper filled the ache
You stepped into my silence
A calm within the storm
And suddenly the pieces
Began to feel reborn
You lift the veil of all I've carried
The weight I thought was mine alone
In every tear your mercy met me
Now I know I'm finally home
So take my heart
Make it your kingdom
Let every wall fall where your light comes
Write your love on every heartbeat raining me
Until I am complete
My heart, your kingdom
There were roads I walked in darkness
There were wounds I hid so deep
But your love kept gently calling
Awakening what fell asleep
You pulled me from the wreckage
You breathed hope into my dust
And from the ashes of my story
You built something I can trust
You take the ruins of my trying
And shape them with a holy hand
You're the peace my soul's been craving
In the one who helps me stand
So take my heart
Make it your kingdom
Let every wall
Fall where your love
On every heart be reigning me
Until I am complete
My heart
Your kingdom
Open every door in me
Let Your presence fill the room
Shine through every memory
And heal the places I once knew
If all I am is Yours, O Lord
Then I will never be alone
You built a kingdom in my heart and called this wandering soul your home
So take my heart, make it your kingdom
Every breath, a place your light runs
Hold my soul till all is restored
Yours forever, now and evermore
My heart, Your kingdom
